next basic attack is empowered while any Notes are active
Notes stack up to 4 per unit (Seraphine included), each contributing one damage instance to the empowered attack; refresh on new casts
Echo stacks up to 2 from ability casts, capped, consumed on next basic ability cast to trigger a free additional cast
Echo-triggered additional cast is a separately timed second cast of the same ability at no cost after a short delay
High Note damage amplified up to 75% based on target's missing health
the max (missing-health-amplified) portion of High Note damage is treated as a cosmetic critical strike

needsBespoke.why: Echo (stacking-self-buff + recast-or-multipart) and Note-stacking (target-stacks + onhit-rider/empowered-attack) combine two primitives each but both combinations are individually expressible; no unique mechanic falls outside the closed list.

options: Echoed cast recalculates all conditional terms independently at its own resolution time
Echoed cast copies the same conditional state as the original cast

Only manually initiated casts grant Echo stacks; the Echoed cast does not generate a new stack

proposal: Start with W (Surround Sound) or another ability cast to seed an Echo stack and grant Seraphine a Note (also useful if survival fight; for damage fight, prioritize damage abilities first).
Open with E (Beat Drop) to build Echo stack #1 and grant a Note, dealing magic damage on cast.
Follow with Q (High Note) to build Echo stack #2 (now at cap) and grant a second Note.

Cast R (Encore) if available: this consumes the 2 Echo stacks, causing Encore to cast twice in quick succession (0.01s delay) after its 0.5s cast time, doubling R's burst damage instance and granting more Notes.
Weave in basic attacks whenever Notes are active (from E/Q/R casts) so the empowered auto-attack fires all stacked Note damage instances at the dummy.
Recast E and Q on cooldown throughout the 15s window (E every ~11s, Q every ~6-8s depending on rank), each refreshing Notes and re-arming Echo.

Manage mana: total costs (Q 60-100, W 70-90, E 60, R 100) versus available mana pool likely limit how many full-cost casts fit in 15s; prioritize E and Q over W since W is defensive-only in the damage fight.
If R is on cooldown for most of the 15s window (base 160s at rank 1), the rotation is effectively Q/E on cooldown plus autos with Notes, with R used once at the start if available.
questions: Should W ever be cast in the pure damage fight, given it produces no direct damage (only a self-shield) but does generate a Note and an Echo stack that empower the next ability/attack?
What champion level and mana pool is assumed for the 15s fight, and does mana realistically allow all of Q/W/E on cooldown plus attacks, or does resource-budget force skipping W?
Is R assumed off cooldown at the start of the 15s fight (i.e., is this a burst-opener scenario) or is R excluded as unavailable within a typical simulated window given its 120-160s cooldown?

How should the simulator treat the Echo double-cast for cooldown/cost purposes — does the second cast start its own instance of any on-cast riders (Notes, Echo generation) or is it purely a damage duplicate?
